class.name: CbForce
class.brief_description: A push for as long as its motion is on: an acceleration, a force, or a pull toward a speed. A thrust, a hook's pull, a current.
class.description: A child of a [CbMotion]. Every tick the motion is on, the target is pushed along the effect's direction. Three kinds ([member kind]): an acceleration moves everything alike, a force moves the heavy less, a velocity brings the target to a speed. A force that rises ([member ramp_in]) is what makes a pull feel heavy, and it also hides latency: other players see your hook a moment late, and by the time the pull is strong they have it. With [member react] the other end takes the same momentum the other way, so weight decides who moves: hooked to a crate, the crate comes to you; hooked to something ten times your weight, you go to it.

members.member: How hard it pushes: metres per second, per second ([constant KIND_ACCELERATION]); newtons ([constant KIND_FORCE]: 800 N on an 80 kg player is 10 m/s per second); or the most the velocity may change in a second ([constant KIND_VELOCITY]).

A speed along the direction, in metres per second. For an acceleration or a force: the top speed, past which it pushes no more (0: none). For [constant KIND_VELOCITY]: the speed it brings the target to (0: it stops it along the direction).
Seconds over which the push rises from nothing to its strength after the motion starts. 0: full at once.
The other end is pushed back with the same momentum: the player, when the force is on something else; what the motion's [CbProbe] found, when it is on the player. The world takes it without moving.

constants.constant: [member strength] in m/s per second, whatever the target weighs. A jetpack, a wind.
[member strength] in newtons: divided by what the target weighs. A hook's pull, a magnet.
The target's speed along the direction goes toward [member speed], by at most [member strength] m/s per second. A conveyor, a tractor beam, a brake.
